sessions.name: Phase 0: Archive & Schema
sessions.notes: Archive + schema complete. 21/21 validation checks passed. Fresh canonical tables live, archive_* preserved, all views/RPCs/RLS rebuilt.

sessions.notes: IDENTITY_RULES.md (14 countries), 265-wine Josh Test sample, 11 pipeline scripts scaffolded, 48/48 Batch 0 producers verified, LWIN CC BY 4.0 confirmed. 9/9 exit criteria pass.

sessions.name: Batch 0: Prototype (50 producers)
sessions.notes: 46 producers, 1,677 wines, 889 wine_grapes, 894 vintages, 3,967 external_ids, 2,335 TTB linked. All 15 exit criteria passed. identity_complete: 53%, avg completeness: 5.6/11. 6 countries: DE(558), FR(430), AU(320), US(172), IT(98), ES(97). New scripts: clean_cuvee.py, build_display_name.py, batch_pipeline.py. Fixes: LWIN name mismatches, 25+ grape blocklist, Rioja appellation, display_name fallback, slug collision handling.

sessions.name: Batch 0 Review + Go/No-Go
sessions.notes: GO for Batch 1. Fixed 2 bugs (cuvee NOT NULL, ALL CAPS grapes). Mini Josh Test 26/30=87%. Schema: wines.name+name_normalized now nullable. Pipeline fixes: grape Title Case, cuvee fallback. 21 grape-in-cuvee dupes noted for Batch 1.

sessions.name: Batch 1 Part 1 (500 producers)
sessions.notes: 542 producers, 16,524 wines, 8,551 wine_grapes, 28,781 COLAs, 16,524 LWIN IDs, 4,842 vintages. Grape-in-cuvee fix. Josh Test 47/50=94%. 80.9% appellation coverage, 51.7% grape coverage, 96.8% color. 1 Joh. Jos. Prum duplicate cleaned. 10 producers with 0 wines (no-LWIN grocery brands).

sessions.name: Batch 1 Part 2 (depth + enrichment)
sessions.notes: Archive recovery via LWIN bridge. +14,021 vintages (5,123 wines), +8,708 grapes (11,444 wines), +1,947 scores (630 wines), +13,980 prices (1,296 wines), +330 farming certs, +2,214 label designations, +5,736 external_ids (UPC/QR). +1,027 appellation_id, +780 region_id, +311 color, +9,943 varietal_category_id, +1,184 wine_type (sparkling/fortified). Staging relinked (10 tables). Avg completeness 5.32->6.29. Data grade: 1,712 F->D. Identity complete: 11,150 (67.5%). Josh Test 33/100 (22% findability expected with 16.5K subset).

sessions.name: Batch 2 (2K producers + depth)
sessions.notes: 2,000 producers processed (1,041 new + 959 existing). +18,564 new wines (51,035 total). +10,146 wine_grapes. Archive depth recovery: +25,365 vintages, +16,279 grapes, +3,473 scores, +9,240 prices. Completeness median 8-9/11 (up from 5-6). All 51,035 wines lwin_matched. 4,406 grade D. 0 errors across full run.

sessions.name: Data Quality Gate + Mass Market
sessions.notes: Champagne wine_type: 1,020 table->sparkling. Fortified colors: +183. Display name artifacts: 57 fixes. 7 producer merges (Chapoutier, Faiveley, Ganevat, Errazuriz, Catena, Roche de Bellene, Fourrier). Krug cross-contamination (11 Austrian) and Ridge/Failla misattribution fixed. Antinori spelling dupes: 3 fixed. Mass-market seeding: +183 wines, +420 vintages, +2,523 COLAs across 18 brands (Josh, Barefoot, Meiomi, etc.). Josh Test v2: 85% (226/265). $0-10 tier: 57%->77%.

sessions.name: Enrichment Sweep (S9+S10 merged)
sessions.notes: Built batch_enrich.py (sequential) and batch_api.py (Anthropic Batch API). Calibrated on 7 wines. First ran sequential (too slow, ~6 wines/min), then switched to Batch API. Grade C: 5,000 submitted, 4,831 succeeded, 169 JSON parse errors (3.4%). Grade B: 60/60 succeeded. Both batches ended in <5 min on Anthropic side. Final: B=105, C=4,857, D=140, F=46,688. wine_insights populated for 4,962 wines (9.6%). Cost: $14.43 batch + $1.20 sequential = $15.76 (vs $28 estimate). Voice quality solid.

sessions.name: Josh Test + Final Validation
sessions.notes: S11 validation: 8 PASS / 3 FAIL / 4 SKIPPED. Josh Test 85.0% (226/265), completeness 8.1/11, provenance 98.5%. Built enrichment_audit.py — Grade C 2.48/5, Grade B 2.65/5, 111 + 91 factual errors flagged. Major finding: enrichment ships factually unreliable copy, must fix before Grade B goes live. Documented push_to_95.md (39 missing wines, <$1 to fix). Phase 3 of 30K plan complete.
